_comment: The VENUE CORPUS, not a payload: what fetch/market-moves.py reads before market-moves/rule.yaml has been applied to it. Field names are Polymarket's own gamma-API shape (id, question, category, liquidityNum, endDate, lastTradePrice, resolutionSource) so the adapter's upgrade path is a urllib GET of https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets and nothing else. The seven markets below are ILLUSTRATIVE, in the venue's published shape and magnitude -- this is not a fetch of Polymarket, and four of the seven are here to be REFUSED by the rule (one under the liquidity floor, one off the category list, one inside the horizon window, one beyond it), so the selection is observably mechanical rather than a list somebody chose.
